name: DeadBolt
description: Gate locally routed agent tool calls with policy, fixed deadlines, one-use approvals and operator revocation. Integrate through Rust, local HTTP or stdio MCP.

skills.name: Gate Tool Dispatch
skills.description: Check locally routed tool calls against an operator-owned policy before dispatch; deny when required state is unavailable.

skills.name: Bound Run Lifetime
skills.description: Enforce a fixed run deadline and optional supervisor-controlled liveness; renewal cannot extend the fixed deadline.

skills.name: Operator Revocation
skills.description: Let a trusted operator pause or kill connected runs; block subsequent calls without claiming to cancel in-flight work.

skills.name: One-use Approvals
skills.description: Require operator-issued one-use grants for configured irreversible actions and reject replay of consumed grants.
